title: Check registry entry
description: The authoring contract. Every field marked required is required because omitting it has produced a specific class of wrong compliance output; see the description on each.

id.description: Stable check identifier. Appears in OSCAL output and in deterministic UUID derivation, so renaming one breaks continuity of its POA&M item.

version.description: Semantic version of the check. A change that alters the verdict for unchanged input is a MAJOR bump, even when the new verdict is more correct: someone holds a published result it contradicts.

component.description: The OSCAL component this check contributes evidence for.

id.description: ISM control id. Validated against the vendored catalog; a typo or a control ASD later withdrew is rejected.

statement_id.description: The OSCAL statement id, always <control-id>_smt. This is what findings target.

statement_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the control statement prose this check was written against. ASD reworded 111 statements in a single quarter while keeping control ids unchanged; without this, a check keeps passing while no longer testing what the control says. CI fails on drift.

coverage.description: How much of the control this check actually covers.

rationale.description: What this check does NOT prove. The most valuable text in the file, because it is the part nobody else supplies. Aggregated into the published coverage statement.

confidence.description: Ceiling, not a claim. An evaluator may lower it at runtime; it may never raise it. Headline compliance figures count `direct` only.

scope.description: `aggregate` for controls that are statements about a population rather than about one host.

evidence_tier.description: `passive` observes only. `active` probes with side effects: opt-in, separate credential, results marked non-reproducible. `mutating` is never valid for a check.

freshness_hours.description: How long an observation stays valid. Enforced at REPORT time, not merely recorded at emit time -- otherwise a host that stopped being collected keeps rendering green and the dashboard gets greener as collection degrades.

history_window_days.description: Non-zero for rate controls -- patch windows, scan cadence. Roughly a quarter of Essential Eight ML1 is temporal rather than stateful. A check that cannot satisfy its window returns unassessed/insufficient-history, never not-satisfied.

evaluator.description: Dotted path to a pure function, module:function. Resolved and imported during registry validation, so a typo fails CI rather than a production run.

references.description: Citations supporting the check objective -- an ASD Blueprint page, a vendor doc. Required when the objective is not self-evident from the control statement.

user_impact.description: What breaks for a user when this is applied. Remediation without a stated impact does not get approved in a change process, so it does not get written here either.

allOf.description: A partial-coverage control needs a rationale long enough to actually say something.
